limitations: Author previously inspected all companies in Sessions 1–3; this is a held-out development split, not a pristine blind test.
Manual gold is positive-only and does not exhaustively label every other valid guidance fact in each document. Unmatched candidates require separate adjudication, not automatic false-positive labels.

Issuer calendar and unqualified consolidated reported revenue basis use documented manual metadata, not textual extraction of those conventions. Metadata accession/exhibit/filing is supplied by SEC corpus inventory.
In-scope unmatched outputs counted conservatively as false positives; positive-only gold does not measure open-world precision. No company-universe expansion or automatic production adoption.

quote_validation.gold_exact_quote_span_not_required: Manual quotations may include multiple rows or arbitrary truncation; candidate must independently occur verbatim at saved offsets.

scope: Document+metric cells represented in fixed positive gold; wrong periods/ranges in those cells count as errors. Other document+metric candidates are unjudged, never assumed correct.
